release_slices.name: F&B import and item image upload hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Stop F&B CSV imports from failing rows with database operation timeouts and make item image upload failures clear and recoverable.
release_slices.purpose: Stabilize F&B item import and Storefront Catalog item image upload without changing payments, checkout totals, POS shift rules, or tenant lifecycle behavior.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Caps row-level CSV import writes to reduce tenant database pool pressure, maps Multer upload-limit errors to client-visible 4xx responses, retries Storefront catalog image override writes without the gallery payload when tenant schemas lag the gallery column, updates targeted backend regression tests, corrects the stale POS terminal contract label expectation, and records compliance impact for the POS-sensitive test file.
included_features: Client-safe item image upload error mapping
Regression tests for import concurrency, upload error mapping, and image repository fallback
Compliance declaration for the POS-sensitive contract-test correction
excluded_features: Checkout totals, payment handling, fiscal receipt calculation, shift-opening logic, and tenant lifecycle changes
Production deployment outside the signed controller
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: CSV imports may process large update/product batches more slowly, and tenants missing the image-gallery column may temporarily store primary image data without gallery metadata until schema catch-up.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: IMS Items CSV import confirm duration for large update/product imports
IMS Storefront Catalog item image upload error messages
Storefront catalog override image metadata persistence on lagging tenant schemas
POS terminal contract test coverage for the DGFY Email label
